lines.en: I walk on the snow without a sound.

lines.zh: 这身白毛在雪里藏得住。
lines.en: This white coat hides well in snow.
All four of my feet are small.
The wind on the ice peaks is hard.

lines.zh: 我沿着冰刺的边走过去。
lines.en: I walk the edge of the ice spikes.
Snow clings to my claws.

lines.zh: 我一步一步朝有热的地方去。
lines.en: Step by step, I head for warmth.
I know this snow slope.
When the wind drops, I dart forward.
Something moves by the frozen river.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，顺着雪坡滑。
lines.en: I lower my body and slide down the snow slope.

lines.zh: 尾巴在后面扫出一道印。
lines.en: My tail leaves a trail behind me.
I lie still in the snow.

lines.zh: 雪林里我蹲着，毛全白了。
lines.en: I crouch in the snow wood, fur all white.
The light on the ice is very white.
I prick my ears up.

lines.zh: 我伏在雪下，听见你的脚步。
lines.en: I lie under the snow, hearing your steps.
I wait here in the snow.
My breathing is nearly silent.
I know this stretch well.
The wind lifts my coat.
Someone is coming from far off.
You crunch loudly on the snow.
I heard you long ago.
In the snow, I barely reach your knee.
But on this snow, I am faster.
Your hand steals toward your belt.
Snow presses my back down an inch.
Your boot has my teeth marks now.
You raise the torch toward me.
The glare blinds me.
I shift into the shade.

lines.zh: 我疼得叫了一声，短得像风。
lines.en: I yelp—short as a gust of wind.
Red stains the white fur.
Back behind the snowbank — it's very white.
The snow covers the blood.

lines.zh: 冻河边上，我的爪印最密。
lines.en: My prints crowd the frozen riverbank.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，白毛盖住伤口。
lines.en: I curl up, white fur covering the wound.
Snow sticks to the wound.
I take one short breath.
I can still move.

lines.zh: 我把耳朵贴回雪面，伏低。
lines.en: I press my ears back to the snow and flatten.

lines.zh: 你手心那点热气，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell the warmth in your palm.
The smell is very faint.
I cannot tell what it is.
Set it on the snow.
Then step away.
That smell on your hands is a little sour.
I do not much want to taste it.
But I am a little hungry still.
My prints in the snow are shallow.
I cannot reach up there.
You are standing on my tail.
I spring clear at once.

lines.zh: 你的靴印和我的爪印打成一团。
lines.en: Your bootprints and my pawprints tangle together.

lines.zh: 你陷得深，我踩在雪面上。
lines.en: You sink deep; I walk on top of the snow.
So I back off first.

lines.zh: 我从你的靴子边溜进雪里。
lines.en: I slip past your boot into the snow.

lines.zh: 雪地上没有绊脚的东西。
lines.en: There is nothing to trip on in the snow.

lines.zh: 你的靴子把我掀了一下。
lines.en: Your boot tips me over.
I roll and come up standing.
I slipped in by your feet.
There are other prints on the peak.
They differ from mine.
I follow them.
Those prints still carry a scent.
It passed only recently.
I trot after it.
The snow covers my tracks.

lines.zh: 我在这条雪坡上来回走。
lines.en: I walk this snow slope back and forth.
I lift my head and call.
Nothing answers on the slope.
Something shows through the snow.
I scratch at it twice.
It is a frozen berry.
I take it in my teeth.
I eat only once far off.
I carry it a stretch.
Nobody on the way back.
I eat behind a stone.
It is frozen hard as stone.
I gnaw at it a long while.
You are standing in my path.
This snowfield is my hunting ground.
I look at your feet first.
You sink deep with every step.
Then you cannot run fast.

lines.zh: 你每一步都陷得深，跑不快。
lines.en: Every step of yours sinks deep; you cannot run.

lines.zh: 你的脚陷在雪里，我盯住了。
lines.en: Your feet are stuck in snow—I've got you.
The snow will cover my scent.
You will only see me once.
Once is enough.
I lie behind a drift.
One step from you, one inch from me.
The snow is loose; I sink only a little.
Your shadow sweeps this way.

lines.zh: 我缩回雪堆，只露出眼睛。
lines.en: I shrink into the drift, only my eyes showing.
My ears lie flat against the snow.
I listen to your heartbeat.
It is getting faster.

lines.zh: 冰封山峰的雪，钻进我的毛。
lines.en: Snow from the frozen peaks works into my fur.
You did not see.
My prints in the snow are shallow.
Yours are deep.
I follow your tracks.

lines.zh: 你一回头，我就停住爪子。
lines.en: The moment you look back, my paws freeze.
So I stopped all four feet.
You walked on again.
So I crept forward a stretch.
Your breathing has grown heavy.
That favors me.

lines.zh: 雪没到你膝盖，我正好跟上。
lines.en: The snow's knee-deep on you—perfect.
Your knees are in the snow.
Every step must be pulled out.
I need not pull free.
My feet are light.
The snow here is soft.
That is bad for you.
You have stopped at last.
Then it is now.

lines.zh: 我从雪里窜出来，一口咬住。
lines.en: I burst from the snow and bite.
My claws reach your leg first.
That was very quick.

lines.zh: 雪太亮，你看不见我这团白。
lines.en: The snow's too bright—you can't see this white blur.
I drop back into the snow.
Only a few shallow prints.
Your blood falls on the snow.
Very visible on the snow.
I circle that spot.
And come again from the other side.
You strike; I dodge.
Snow sprays upward.
This time I bite and hold.
Your hands cannot catch me.
I am too small.

lines.zh: 我从雪里窜起，再咬一口。
lines.en: I burst from the snow and bite again.
Then I pull back into the snow.
And wait for you to bleed.
I bite and pull back at once.
I do not linger in a fight.
A gust rises over the peak.

lines.zh: 雪堆裂开，我先探出两只耳朵。
lines.en: The snowdrift cracks; my ears come out first.
The white here is blinding.

lines.zh: 我抖落背上的雪，露出白毛。
lines.en: I shake the snow off my back, baring white fur.
Something living is nearby.

lines.zh: 冰刺之间，我闻到活物的热气。
lines.en: Between the ice spikes, I smell a warm body.
I slip out between the ice spikes.
I am alone on the snowfield.
The mountains beyond are white.

lines.zh: 我抬头，雪风里有点血腥。
lines.en: I lift my head—there's blood on the snow wind.
Something is in it.
I go over a small step at a time.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的毛，我打了个滚。
lines.en: Fire catches my coat and I roll.
I slide down the ice slope.

lines.zh: 冰水灌进嘴里，我拼命划。
lines.en: Icy water fills my mouth; I paddle hard.
A sheet of snow is thrown up.
Something sticks in my hind leg.

lines.zh: 那光让我的毛全竖起来。
lines.en: That light makes my coat stand on end.
When hungry, I cannot run fast.
Lightning strikes the snow in a sheet of white.
The ground gives and I fall into the white.
